name: Hue food guide
summary: Hue’s kitchen is herbal, spicy, and proud of its imperial small plates. Bun bo Hue is the bowl to judge the city by.
body: Start with bun bo Hue. Add banh beo, banh nam, and the other steamed cakes if a shop serves a mixed plate. Com hen, rice with tiny clams, is a local lunch.
Court-style banquets are a set piece for visitors. They are optional. A morning soup tells you more about how the city eats.
seoDescription: What to eat in Hue, including bun bo Hue and the small imperial cakes.
